items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: And the one for Jimmy Smith was done at the Apollo Theater, and the one for Lionel Hampton was done at the Metropole... So I had the pleasure of making these awards to these three artists.

ctx.x: Yeah. That’s where it was happening.

It was happening. Out here on the coast there were a lot of things happening and he got to know some of the people who were recording. You know it’s a very small industry. Everybody knows what everybody else is doing. And he liked what he was hearing, but he couldn’t get into that, and he appreciated those who were — you know, Dave Brubeck, John [Paul] Desmond — the different guys who were great artists, but he could hardly get the guys that he had, you know? They were being taken away. You know the story about…
Oh that has to be frustrating.
